_comment: Hand-curated mapping from the save file's internal Quests.QuestName tag to the wiki page (Cargo Quests._pageName) that documents it. The wiki's Quests table has no field that joins cleanly to the save's internal tags (unlike Items, which has InternalTag), so this was built by manually cross-referencing each tag's segments (task type / location / related item keywords) against theforeverwinter.wiki.gg quest data. Tags not listed here fall back to a prettified version of the raw tag at render time -- see saveService.js's questFriendlyData(). Regenerate consumers via `npm run quests:generate` after editing this file.
Quest.Bunco.Initial.Fetch.Ashen.Water: Down to the Last Drop Pt.2
Quest.Bunco.Initial.Fetch.Stairway.Water: Down to the Last Drop Pt.1
Quest.Bunco.Initial.Fetch.Underground.Wa: Down to the Last Drop Pt.3
